events.title: Visual Basic 1.0 released
events.summary: [Microsoft] launched Visual Basic at Comdex, bringing drag-and-drop [GUI] development to Windows with a Basic dialect.
events.about: Visual Basic let non-specialists build Windows desktop apps: drag buttons and text boxes onto a form, double-click to write event code. Typical apps: in-house inventory tools, small-business accounting front-ends, data-entry screens, and line-of-business CRUD programs — without learning Win32 C [API].

narrative.whyChosen: VB democratized Windows app development for a generation of business programmers.
narrative.whyImportant: It paired a visual form designer with event-driven code — a model later copied across industry tools.
narrative.problemSolved: Building Windows UIs in C or raw [API] calls was slow; VB made [GUI] apps accessible to non-specialists.
